summary: Change Agents Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Business Loan and Security Agreement with a commercial lender on July 24, 2026, obtaining an $825,000 loan with net proceeds of $254,350 after fees and repayment of a prior loan. The loan is repayable in 30 weekly installments of $37,125, maturing March 3, 2027. The company granted a security interest in collateral and subsidiaries guaranteed the loan. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation. What to watch: the company's liquidity and ability to meet payment obligations.
